load-failed: Error toast when the schedule could not be loaded.
missing.title: Page heading when the schedule doesn't exist or belongs to someone else.
missing.description: Under the heading when the schedule isn't there; <all> links to the list of schedules.
meta: Line under the schedule's title: {{socio}} the socio's name (an AI agent), {{job}} the job it runs; <all> links to the list of schedules. The _mine forms add that the person made it themselves.
meta-deleted-job: Like the line above, when the job was deleted.
meta-turn: Like the line above, for a schedule that runs a socio turn (a conversation turn with the AI model).
purpose.title: Card heading: what the schedule is for.
purpose.goal: Card description when the schedule works on a goal.
purpose.job: Card description when the schedule runs a job (code, run without the AI model).
purpose.turn: Card description when the schedule runs a socio turn: the card shows its prompt.
purpose.runs-job: {{job}} is the job's name; <code> links to the Jobs tab, with its code and logs.
purpose.runs-deleted-job: The same, when the job was deleted.
progress.title: Card heading on a schedule that works toward a goal: the goal and its progress so far.
progress.description: Card description: the socio writes a note after each run.
progress.latest: Label before the socio's latest progress note.
progress.none: Shown in the goal progress card when the socio (AI agent) hasn't written a progress note yet.
comments.title: Card heading over a goal's comments, written by the person and by the socio.
comments.description: Card description of a goal's comments.
comments.the-socio: Stands in for the socio's name when it was deleted.
facts.title: Card heading: the schedule's settings, one per row.
facts.socio: Row label in the What it does card: the socio (AI agent) that runs the schedule.
facts.runs: Row label: how often it runs (the server's words, e.g. "Every weekday at 09:00").
facts.once: It runs once, without a cadence.
facts.next: Row label over the next run times.
facts.none: No next runs; the paused form says why.
facts.zone: Row label: the time zone the schedule's times are in.
facts.zone-note: After the schedule's time zone: its cadence is in that zone; the next runs above show in the reader's.
facts.posts: Row label: the chat where its runs post.
facts.no-chat: In the Posts in row: the schedule's runs don't post in any chat.
facts.approvals: Row label: which actions the schedule's runs may take without asking the person first.
facts.approvals-some: {{items}} lists what its runs may do without asking, each with its policy (a list).
facts.approval: One of those: {{label}} names a capability (e.g. "Create a dataset"); bypass means it goes ahead without asking; the auto form means a decision model reviews it.
facts.approvals-none: Its runs ask the person before anything that needs approval.
facts.policies: Link to the socio's approval policies.
facts.status: Row label: the schedule's status badge, with a note on what that status means.
standing.paused: Note beside the status badge: what the status means for the schedule.
standing.cancelled: Note beside the status badge: what the status means for the schedule.
standing.failed: Note beside the status badge: what the status means for the schedule.
standing.completed: Note beside the status badge: what the status means for the schedule.
standing.running: Note beside the status badge: what the status means for the schedule.
standing.active: Note beside the status badge: what the status means for the schedule.
cancel: Button that opens the dialog to cancel the schedule.
runs.title: Card heading over the schedule's past runs.
runs.description: Description of the What it has done card: the schedule's past runs, newest first.
runs.took: After a run's start time: how long it took ({{duration}}, e.g. "2 min, 5 sec").
runs.open: Link to the run's turn in its chat.
runs.board.create: Link under a run to what it did on the Improvements board; {{issue}} is an issue key such as CB-12.
runs.board.comment: Link under a run to what it did on the Improvements board; {{issue}} is an issue key such as CB-12.
runs.board.vote: Link under a run to what it did on the Improvements board; {{issue}} is an issue key such as CB-12.
runs.board.unvote: Link under a run to what it did on the Improvements board; {{issue}} is an issue key such as CB-12.
runs.board.update: Link under a run to what it did on the Improvements board; {{issue}} is an issue key such as CB-12.
